app.title: webnoveltoepub
app.tagline: Convert web novels into EPUB files. Self-hosted.
language.label: Language
form.url.label: Novel URL
form.url.hint: Paste the link to the novel's main page (the one with the chapter list).
supported.title: Supported sites
novel.author: Author
chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.limit_warning: The server caps a single EPUB at {max} chapters. Extra chapters will be dropped.
options.title: Options
library.title: Library
library.hint: Every conversion is remembered here, so you can pull in new chapters later without downloading the whole novel again.
library.empty: Nothing here yet — convert a novel and it will show up.
library.no_file: No EPUB on disk — this entry is history only. Turn on WNE_SAVE_TO_DISK to be able to update it.
library.confirm_delete_file: Also delete the EPUB file of "{title}" from disk?
convert.working: Generating EPUB — this can take a few minutes for long novels…
convert.done: Done. Your download should start automatically.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid http(s) URL.
error.unsupported_site: No parser supports this site yet. See the README for how to add one.
error.parser_error: The parser could not read this page. The site layout may have changed.
error.fetch_error: Could not reach the site. It may be down, rate-limiting, or blocking bots.
error.playwright_unavailable: This site needs JavaScript rendering, which the .exe build does not include (Chromium is ~300 MB and is not bundled). Use the Docker version for this site.
footer.notice: Use it for content you are allowed to download, and respect each site's terms of service.
job.stopped: Stopped. What was downloaded has been kept.
settings.title: Automatic updates
settings.auto_update: Check the library for new chapters automatically
settings.auto_update_hint: Off by default. When on, the whole library is checked on the interval below and new chapters are appended to the existing EPUBs.
settings.check_on_startup: Also check shortly after the app starts
settings.exe_note: In the Windows .exe the app only runs while its window is open, so an interval measured in hours will rarely fire. Under Docker or CasaOS the app stays running and the schedule works non-stop.
settings.history_empty: No automatic check has run yet.
error.stopped_empty: Stopped before any chapter was downloaded, so nothing was saved.
